task.title: Recipe removal can't be found on a phone
task.description:
Corrected 2026-11-18: removal already exists. The owner found it in the desktop web view but not on their phone (Android, Brave, dev site).

What exists (components/recipes/recipe-detail.tsx, convex/recipeCards.ts):
- The recipe page has 'Remove recipe' (recipes you own; soft delete, sets deletedAt) or 'Remove from Recipe Book' (saved recipes from elsewhere; removes the saved entry), each behind a confirmation.
- It is a small text button in the second row of actions under the title, after Favorite, Edit recipe and View original.
- There is no remove action in the Recipe Book list itself.

Not yet known: why it was not found on the phone. Nothing in the markup obviously hides it at phone width. Reproduce at phone width first: it may be hidden or clipped by layout, or just hard to spot.

Wanted:
- Removal reachable and easy to find on a phone, from the recipe page and ideally from the Recipe Book list (for clearing out several stray recipes).
- A planner slot whose recipe was removed already shows '<name> was removed from your Recipe Book'; confirm that reads well.

Related: 'Planner Cook slot: pick the right recipe instead of silently creating one' (source of the stray recipes).
